prompt: A photograph from a lens fixed high in the corner of a cramped attic, looking down diagonally at a pine desk under a bare bulb. Brandon sits at the desk with a printed sheaf of paper flat in front of him, one finger under a line of text that is too small to read, his mouth slightly open and brows raised in wonder. A desk lamp with a cracked plastic shade, a cold mug and a wire pen pot crowd the desk. The light is a single warm bulb plus a grey window, with heavy grain and washed-out colour. Thanks.
